# osgdoc — Small Tools for Documentation

This LuaLaTeX package provides a thin wrapper around the `cnltx-doc` class,
as well as a few additional macros for documentation, especially the automatic
documentation of TeX and Lua source code.

For documentation, see `osgdoc-en.pdf` or `osgdoc-de.pdf`.

Released under the LaTeX Project Public License v1.3c or later.
See <https://www.latex-project.org/lppl.txt>.

## Dependencies

Dependencies on other packages of this project and on selected third-party
packages; the usual LaTeX packages the code loads itself are not listed.

- Required at run time: `cnltx`
- Required to build the documentation (`l3build doc`): `langselect`, `cnltx`
- Required to run the test suite (`l3build check`): `cnltx`

This package is developed in the same repository as the osglecture document class, see https://github.com/werner-matthias/osglecture, but works on its own.
